messages:
Ivy K: FYI scheduling a quiet-window deploy at 23:45 UTC for feature flag `model-route-smooth` (model v3.2). Regional order: EU -> NA -> APAC. Ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Soak: EU 10m, NA 20m, APAC 20m. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/model-route-smooth

Sam B: Confirming we should pin v2 for APAC until APAC reaches 50%? Last time APAC degraded after we unpinned too soon.

Ivy K: Yes, pin v2 for APAC until 50% stable. EU/NA will unpin at 10% after soak. If any gate trips, fallback to pinned version for that region.

Infra: Make sure cohorts exclude staging and internal agents: use `--exclude-cohorts staging_* --exclude-cohorts internal_*`. Also routing buckets must not include canary namespaces.

Ivy K: Runbook snippet for ops:
```
# start EU at 1%
/ff toggle model-route-smooth --region eu --pct 1 --exclude-cohorts staging_* --exclude-cohorts internal_*
# bump EU to 10%
/ff toggle model-route-smooth --region eu --pct 10
# emergency disable and pin v2
/ff toggle model-route-smooth --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "auto-rollback or manual"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Ivy K at 2026-03-21T23:45:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 (1%). Will post health checks at +5m and +10m.

oncall-bot: Telemetry gates: p95_latency, request_error_rate, 99th_token_latency. Auto-fallback rule: if error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > baseline + 200ms for 2 consecutive windows, set region pct to 0 and re-pin to v2. Will page oncall and post to #eng-releases.

Ivy K: Release notes draft: "model-route-smooth v3.2: phased rollout to smooth p95 and reduce tail latency. Per-region v2 pins for APAC until 50%; automatic rollback rules in place."

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 1%. Monitoring: #eng-releases and #eng-oncall.

Infra: Confirmed exclusion lists applied to EU cohort.

deploy-bot: Canary EU healthy at 5m check. No spikes. Proceed on plan.

Sam B: Proceeding to NA 10% in 2m. Will monitor tail latencies and token-cost-rate.

(End of thread)
